Thanks for reaching out and for the context. I’m Ava from the PLG support team — happy to help get you what you need for the POC. Quick questions so I can triage internally:

- Can you confirm the account email (ops@acme.ai) is the same one you used to sign up?
- Is there a specific API key or project name we should apply credits to?
- Are you requesting a one-time credit top-up ($500) or an extension of the existing trial window (30 days)?

Proposal: For PLG signups we typically issue up to $200 auto promos. Since they have a timebox (demo next Wed) and this appears to be a genuine POC, recommend either:

- Option A: One-time $500 credit (apply to account) — requires billing sign-off but is reasonable for potential ACV; OR
- Option B: 30-day trial extension + $150 promo code (quicker, lower cost)

If you and Vivek sign off, I’ll apply the credit/code and notify the customer. If we go with Option A, Vivek, can you confirm we have budget/velocity to approve $500 for ACME-3245?
